search_label: School name, country, or Moodle URL
search_placeholder: Search schools or paste your Moodle address
contact_hint: Choosing a school contacts that school and may download its logo.
privacy_hint: Search stays on this device. Choosing a school or checking a URL contacts that school and may download its logo. Requests appear in Settings > Privacy.
no_results: No matching schools in the bundled directory. You can still connect using your school’s Moodle URL.
multiple_accounts: You can connect several schools and accounts. Existing connections stay signed in.
qr_unsupported: QR sign-in is not available here. Enter your school’s Moodle address, then use your school account or single sign-on.
signup_disabled: Use an existing school account. Self-registration is not available in VStudy. Contact your school if you need an account.
signup_browser: Create your account on your school’s Moodle website, then return here to sign in.
unsupported_login: This school uses an unsupported login method.
unsupported_login_next: Ask your school administrator about Moodle mobile web service access.
https_required: Use your school’s HTTPS Moodle address. Insecure HTTP sites are not supported.
